answer_1.quote: We trained the TransferTOD-7B model ... the model can proactively ask users for missing information, accurately fill slots, and efficiently guide fluent response generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated dialogue responses and filled slots

answer_2.quote: For evaluating the slot filling ability, we employ F1 and Joint Accuracy ... To evaluate the semantic accuracy of model-generated questions, we use a manual evaluation approach. We also use Ask Accuracy and Ask Fluency metrics.

answer_3.quote: The method we employed, which combines GPT-based assessment with expert review, is a widely adopted approach for evaluating the language fluency of models.

answer_4.quote: Human experts manually created a set of high-quality dialogues as test data ... We manually revised the dataset and employed a hierarchical scoring system to evaluate the models' query smoothness.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated questions on fluency and semantic accuracy using defined criteria.
